messages:
kevin_pm: Heads-up — ACME Compute just sent the final assets for our joint solution brief. Need a quick pass on: logo lockups (vertical + horizontal), hero image crop, localized CTA text for EU/JP, alt text for accessibility, and any legal flags. Pinged everyone who should weigh in.

leon_design: Thanks — downloading now. Initial note: hero image has 3840x2160 but ACME provided a heavy color overlay that conflicts with our brand palette. Will try a lighter treatment and share two crops in ~30m.

sasha_marketing: For CTAs, propose: EN: "Start with Redwood + ACME"; EU (formal): "Get started with Redwood & ACME"; JP: "Redwood と ACME を始める" — can someone natcheck JP? Also recommend shorter microcopy for marketplace tile: "Deploy faster on ACME hardware."

tara_legal: Quick legal flags: ACME logo usage requires full lockup for co-branded assets, and we must include their trademark mark on first appearance. Also need written approval for customer quote if we include one. I'll verify signature on the logo usage doc.

maya_solutions: We have one customer quote from BetaCo that references ACME by name. Can we confirm BetaCo already signed their case consent? If not, I'll follow up — we can't publish until we have that. Also suggest a short technical blurb (2 lines) for the marketplace listing.

kevin_pm: BetaCo consent is in progress — thx. Leon, for the hero crops can you try both a lighter overlay and a version with ambient blur on the background so text has contrast? Also include an A/B with a product shot vs. abstract cloud.

leon_design: Yep. Will export specs and PNG/SVG lockups. Quick note for the lockup: ACME requires 24px clearspace around their mark at our output size; I think our current layout violates that at mobile widths. Will propose adjusted spacing.

asset_bot: File uploaded: "acme_redwood_lockups_v3.zip" (4 files) — link: https://files.redwood.com/acme/redwood-lockups-v3.zip

sasha_marketing: Thanks. For marketplace localization — we should avoid idioms in JP and DE. Suggested CTAs for DE: "Mit Redwood & ACME starten". Also: alt text should be descriptive, e.g., "Redwood inference dashboard on ACME hardware with throughput chart." Keep under 125 chars.

tara_legal: Also confirm the partner wants the joint logo on the marketplace thumbnail — some partners prefer separate logos in the listing header instead of embedded lockups. I can loop in ACME legal if we need a deviation.

maya_solutions: If we use the product shot for hero, can we get a clear screenshot without customer data? Leon, if you need a sanitized screenshot, I can request from infra.

leon_design: Please do — sanitized screenshot would be ideal. If not available, I'll create an illustrated variant. Sharing two hero comps in thread in ~25m.

kevin_pm: Timeline: need final assets for engineering and marketplace QA by EOD Friday. Can we lock everything by Thu EOD to give QA a day?

sasha_marketing: Agree. I'll draft the marketplace copy once we have the final hero + CTAs. Will also prep the alt text spreadsheet for localization.

tara_legal: I'll have logo usage confirmation and trademark callouts by Wed. If any quote approvals are missing, I will escalate.

maya_solutions: I'll chase BetaCo today and request sanitized screenshot if possible.

kevin_pm: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. If anyone wants a short sync, 15m after Leon posts comps. :thumbsup:

leon_design: Uploaded comps: https://files.redwood.com/acme/hero-comps-2024-06.png — two variants (product shot, abstract). Notes in the image: font sizes, lockup spacing, CTA placement.

sasha_marketing: Look good, lean towards product-shot hero A for marketplace tile. JP natcheck pending from @yuki_localization — tagging separately.

tara_legal: Received. No red flags so far on the assets themselves. Waiting on partner sign-off for the combined lockup usage.

kevin_pm: Cool — I'll consolidate approvals and post final checklist here once BetaCo and ACME sign off. Thanks team.
